note: Incident descriptions for the scale retrieval evaluation (ctx dataset eval, docs/evaluation.md part 3). One entry per problem (= ground-truth topic of the company dataset, src/context_layer/dataset/knowledge.py). Written by hand on 2026-11-08, before any matcher, in the words an incident or a field engineer would use, deliberately NOT the generator's wording. `dev` is used to tune thresholds, `test` only to report. {el} is the element id, {site} the site name. `observations` are what an agent typically knows on such a case (fields of models.OBSERVABLE_FIELDS). `family` groups problems that are the same problem for the agent: knowledge of the same family counts as acceptable, not as noise.

sfp-swap-port-reinit.dev: Field engineer replaced the SFP on {el}; the interface has not come back up since.
sfp-swap-port-reinit.test: New transceiver fitted on {el} this morning but the port is still down.

stuck-link-after-swap.dev: After changing the optic on {el} the link will not recover.
stuck-link-after-swap.test: {el}: link not working after we replaced the optical transceiver.

autoneg-mismatch-after-reboot.dev: {el} restarted overnight and the uplink now runs at 1 Gbit/s instead of 10 Gbit/s.
autoneg-mismatch-after-reboot.test: Port speed on {el} fell to 1G after the node was rebooted.

fan-alarm-dust.dev: Fan failure alarm on {el} keeps re-raising a few minutes after we clear it.
fan-alarm-dust.test: {el}: cooling fan alarm returns every time it is acknowledged.

ptp-resync-after-power-cycle.dev: {el} was powered off and on, and now shows a PTP timing alarm.
ptp-resync-after-power-cycle.test: Clock synchronisation lost on {el} after the power was cycled.

cold-module-flaps.dev: Link on {el} goes up and down during the night, outside temperature -25 C.
cold-module-flaps.test: {el}: interface bouncing repeatedly in the freezing weather.

licence-lost-after-upgrade.dev: After the software upgrade on {el} several ports show as unlicensed.
licence-lost-after-upgrade.test: {el} lost its port licenses when the new firmware was installed.

slow-commit-do-not-abort.dev: Configuration commit on {el} has been running for six minutes and looks stuck.
slow-commit-do-not-abort.test: {el}: the config change is not finishing, the CLI seems frozen on commit.

second-uplink-drops-traffic.dev: Packet loss on {el} as soon as traffic is moved to uplink port 2.
second-uplink-drops-traffic.test: {el} drops traffic when we use the second uplink.

microwave-fade-fix.dev: Microwave link on {el} degrades every evening around 19:00.
microwave-fade-fix.test: {el}: microwave signal fading in the evenings.

memory-leak-reboot.dev: {el} has become very sluggish, uptime is over two months.
memory-leak-reboot.test: {el}: management very slow, memory nearly full.

admin-lockout-persists.dev: Local admin account on {el} is locked after failed logins and still locked after a reboot.
admin-lockout-persists.test: Cannot log in to {el} as admin, the lockout survived the restart.

counter-wrap-32bit.dev: Traffic graphs for {el} show sudden drops to zero, but customers report no problem.
counter-wrap-32bit.test: {el}: interface statistics look wrong in the graphs while traffic is fine.

antenna-tilt-drift.dev: Throughput on {el} went down after last night's strong winds.
antenna-tilt-drift.test: {el}: sector capacity reduced since the gale passed.

wet-snow-throughput-loss.dev: Heavy wet snowfall today and {el} delivers only half its normal throughput.
wet-snow-throughput-loss.test: {el}: snow building up on the antenna, capacity is halved.

lightning-vswr-false-alarm.dev: High VSWR alarm on {el} since the thunderstorm.
lightning-vswr-false-alarm.test: {el}: VSWR alarm raised after lightning hit nearby.

heater-breaker-trips-in-cold.dev: Cabinet heater of {el} not working, it is -32 C outside.
heater-breaker-trips-in-cold.test: {el}: no heating in the cabinet during the extreme cold.

battery-alarm-clears-itself.dev: Battery alarm on {el} since the mains power cut this morning.
battery-alarm-clears-itself.test: {el}: battery alarm raised after the grid outage.

access.dev: Engineer dispatched to {site} for {el}: how do we get on site?
access.test: Truck roll to {el} at {site} tomorrow, any access instructions?
